rationale: Existing op09 raw slots have no encoded-output FIFO; exact source and matrix confirm the gap.
Two-slot full-frame store-and-forward is input-ready on frozen internal metadata/payload wires and does not require new public ABI.
Conservative old-state credit, complete-before-visible storage and explicit fault/cancel rules define testable safety and throughput behavior.
Independent accepted-edge oracle and new exact-source composition cover behavior; no old suite rerun or first-capture reimplementation.
corrections_before_freeze: Error3 standalone opaque transport test does not assign an op09/public enum.
Composition uses op09 with its already-instantiated op08 encoder, not two encoders in series.
authorization: One concrete implementation and independent product-main verification/publication to existing PR30. No intermediate scope-only waiting step if frozen invariants hold.
prior_decisions: op19 bounded Python repair accepted and consumed; op18 historical REVISE retained; no whole-card promotion.
